title: Tech Xpress
description: An electronics e-commerce platform focused on a smooth shopping experience, responsive access, and dependable order workflows.
architecture: Built as a full-stack ASP.NET Core MVC application using Entity Framework Core and SQL Server. The project includes product catalog and account features, Stripe payment integration, and a responsive jQuery interface. Azure was used in the technology stack.

title: E-Learning Platform with AI Chatbot
description: A graduation project that helps students explore technology resources, learning paths, books, and instructor content with support from an AI chatbot.
architecture: An ASP.NET Core MVC application using ASP.NET Identity, SQL Server, and Razor views. The chatbot supports learner questions and guidance. The project was completed as a team graduation project and received an Excellent project grade, as listed on the CV.

title: El Wakeel Law Firm Website
description: A freelance project: a responsive professional website for a legal consultancy, presenting services and giving prospective clients a direct way to get in touch.
architecture: A front-end website built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery, Owl Carousel, and Font Awesome. Formspree was used for contact form submissions.
